book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, no translation used

sentences.ar: يوم سوق بغودرفيل، والطرق مليانة فلاحين ونسوان وبقر.
sentences.en: Market day at Goderville, and the roads full of peasants and women and cattle.

sentences.ar: والعم هوشكورن، فلاح عجوز من قرية قريبة، ماشي عالساحة.
sentences.en: And old Hauchecorne, a peasant from a nearby village, walking to the square.
And he saw on the ground a small piece of string.

sentences.ar: وهو فلاح، والفلاح ما بيترك شي عالأرض.
sentences.en: And he was a peasant, and a peasant leaves nothing on the ground.

sentences.ar: انحنى، على مهل، لأنه ظهره بيوجعه، وأخد الخيط، وبلش يلفه.
sentences.en: He bent, slowly, because his back hurt, took the string, and began winding it.

sentences.ar: وبنفس اللحظة، شاف واحد بيتطلع فيه من باب دكانه.
sentences.en: And in that same moment, he saw someone watching him from his shop door.

sentences.ar: مالاندان، السراج، وبينهم خصومة قديمة، على حساب.
sentences.en: Malandain, the harness-maker, and between them an old quarrel, over an account.

sentences.ar: استحى هوشكورن إنه شافه بيلم خيط.
sentences.en: Hauchecorne was ashamed to be seen picking up string.

sentences.ar: فخبى الخيط بجيبه بسرعة، وعمل حاله بيدور على شي تاني.
sentences.en: So he hid the string in his pocket quickly, and pretended to look for something else.
And went on to the market.

sentences.ar: عالظهر، بالمطعم، والكل بياكل، دخل الحارس، وقرا إعلان.
sentences.en: At noon, at the inn, with everyone eating, the town crier came in, and read a notice.

sentences.ar: ضاعت محفظة سودا، فيها خمسمية فرنك وأوراق، عالطريق الصبح.
sentences.en: A black wallet was lost, with five hundred francs and papers, on the road this morning.

sentences.ar: ومين يلاقيها، يرجعها للبلدية، وإله مكافأة.
sentences.en: And whoever finds it, return it to the town hall, for a reward.

sentences.ar: وبعد شوي، إجا شرطي، وقال: العم هوشكورن، رئيس البلدية بده يشوفك.
sentences.en: And a little later, a policeman came, and said: old Hauchecorne, the mayor wants to see you.

sentences.ar: وبالبلدية، الرئيس قال: شافوك الصبح وإنت بتلم المحفظة عالطريق.
sentences.en: And at the town hall, the mayor said: you were seen this morning picking up the wallet on the road.
Hauchecorne said: me?
A wallet?
I picked up a piece of string!
And took the string from his pocket.
The mayor said: Mr. Malandain saw you.
And he is a respectable man.
Hauchecorne said: liar!
He hates me!
String!
String!
They searched him, and found nothing.

sentences.ar: وتركوه يروح، بس الرئيس قال: بنشوف.
sentences.en: And let him go, but the mayor said: we will see.

sentences.ar: وطلع هوشكورن للسوق، وصار يحكي للناس.
sentences.en: And Hauchecorne went out to the market, and began telling people.
Everyone.
The string, Malandain, the injustice.
And people listened, and laughed, and did not believe.

sentences.ar: وتاني يوم، خادم بمزرعة لقى المحفظة عالطريق، ورجعها لصاحبها، بكل اللي فيها.
sentences.en: And the next day, a farmhand found the wallet on the road, and returned it to its owner, with everything in it.

sentences.ar: وهوشكورن سمع، وفرح، وراح للسوق يحكي: شفتوا؟
sentences.en: And Hauchecorne heard, and rejoiced, and went to the market to tell: you see?
You see?

sentences.ar: وحكى القصة كلها، من الخيط للمحفظة.
sentences.en: And told the whole story, from the string to the wallet.

sentences.ar: بس الناس ضحكوا، وواحد قال: أي، رجعتها.
sentences.en: But people laughed, and one said: yes, it was returned.

sentences.ar: رجعها واحد تاني عنك، بعد ما شفت إنهم عرفوك.
sentences.en: Someone else returned it for you, after you saw they knew you.
And here his misfortune began.

sentences.ar: كل ما يحكي، الناس تصدق أقل.
sentences.en: The more he told, the less people believed.
He would stop people on the road, and tell.
And go to other markets, and tell.

sentences.ar: وكل ما يحكي أكتر، الناس تقول: هاد بيدافع كتير.
sentences.en: And the more he told, the more people said: this one protests too much.
Only the guilty protest so.

sentences.ar: وصار يحلم بالخيط، ويحكي عنه بالنوم.
sentences.en: And he began dreaming of the string, and talking of it in his sleep.
And weakened, and fell ill, and took to his bed.

sentences.ar: وبآخر أيامه، كان يقول، للحيط، وللخادمة، وللكل: خيط زغير.
sentences.en: And in his last days, he would say, to the wall, to the maid, to them all: a little string.
String.
Look, Mr. Mayor.
And died saying: string.
